plans.idea: Faithful to the original's reading order on one centred axis: brand at top, a full-width sneaker as the visual anchor, a big headline and subhead block under it, then a wide CTA pill. Every element is scaled up so the tall canvas has no dead bands.

Headline-first story layout: the logo sits over a large headline and subhead in the upper third, the sneaker fills the middle as the payoff, and the CTA closes at the bottom, so the eye reads straight down from message to product to action.

Left-aligned editorial grid: the logo, headline, subhead and CTA stack tightly on a shared left edge in the top half as one message block, and the sneaker takes the whole bottom half as a weighty product base.
